subject: Publisher account: asset ingestion + identity evidence for offer creation
messages:
From: Lily Chan <lily.chan@acme.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: cloudadmin@acme.com
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood offer publish - what we need from you

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We're ready to start the Azure Marketplace flow from our side but the ISV portal flagged a couple of items we need to hand back to Redwood before we can submit the offer for co-sell review: 

1) Publisher identity evidence: incorporation doc + primary contact verification (name & email).
2) Offer assets: logo (PNG), three marketing bullet points, long description, and SKU-level pricing CSV.
3) Technical proof: a short deployment manifest that shows the outbound endpoints and any required inbound ports for ACME integration tests.

Can you and your team drop the identity PDF and a draft sku CSV into a shared location and confirm who will be the technical contact for marketplace validation? We want to avoid back-and-forth with Microsoft support.

I'll loop in Marketplace Support if needed but hoping to keep the first pass internal between our teams.

Best,
Lily Chan
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Logistics
[Attachment: acme_request_summary.pdf (pdf)]

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Lily Chan <lily.chan@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood offer publish - what we need from you

Lily — thanks, and appreciated the clear checklist. We're ready to proceed. Quick plan and owners: 

- Publisher identity evidence: I'll attach the signed incorporation statement and vendor verification PDF in this thread (see attachment). Owner: Vivek Kulkarni (me).
- Offer assets: Marissa will own the marketing copy, logo, and shop-ready descriptions. Owner: Marissa Cole (cc'd).
- SKU/pricing CSV: Olga will draft the SKU mapping and format it to the portal schema. Owner: Olga Petrov (cc'd).
- Technical proof / manifest: Karthik will produce a trimmed-down ARM template + network egress doc for the ACME integration tests. Owner: Karthik Iyer (cc'd).

Next actions: 
1) I'll drop publisher_identity_doc.pdf and company verification into our shared folder and post the link here by EOD.
2) Marissa will circulate the 3-line bullets + 300-word description by tomorrow morning.
3) Olga will attach sku_mapping_v2.csv for you to review (format: skuId, skuName, price, billingType, meterName).
4) Karthik will outline the minimal network ports and post an ARM snippet for review.

If ACME would like an expedited review with MS marketplace, we can add "marketplace-support@microsoft.com" to the thread. Let me know.

Thanks — Vivek
VP, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: publisher_identity_doc.pdf (pdf)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Lily Chan <lily.chan@acme.com>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 08:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood offer publish - what we need from you

Hi Lily / team,

Uploading initial marketing assets now. Attached: 3 short bullets, two-sentence elevator, and a 300-word marketing description. A few notes:

- Bullets emphasize low-latency inference, predictable costs with Dedicated plans, and enterprise controls (VPC/HSM).
- Request: confirm which ACME logo variant you prefer (horizontal vs stacked) — attached both as acme-logo-300.png.
- We'll format the portal long description to match MS character limits; if you'd like custom co-sell messaging ("joint solution for logistics routing"), tell me and I'll tailor.

I'll also produce the portal-ready Markdown and a short README for the offer assets.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Product Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: offer_bullets_and_long_description.md (md)]

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lily.chan@acme.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 13:15:00 -08:00
Subject: SKU mapping + format for portal ingestion

Lily / Vivek — attaching the SKU CSV in the portal schema. A few implementation notes below.

[Attachment: sku_mapping_v2.csv (csv)]

CSV columns included: skuId, skuDisplayName, priceUSD, billingType, meterName, sampleLimits. Sample rows include a Dedicated monthly, a metered per-token plan, and an Enterprise annual commit SKU.

Important: Azure marketplace requires price keys in USD and a specific SKU identifier pattern. If Acme needs an EU pricing tier, we will need a separate row (we can generate once we confirm region). Also: include the company contact email in the offer metadata to satisfy identity routing.

Let me know if you want me to also author the portal manifest JSON for ingestion — happy to do that and push to the shared folder.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Partner Integrations Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Lily Chan <lily.chan@acme.com>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, marketplace-support@microsoft.com
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood offer publish - what we need from you

Lily / ACME / MS support — attaching a minimal ARM snippet and a short network egress doc to show the endpoints used during our integration tests. This is what's typically requested by marketplace validation to confirm there are no inbound ports required and all control planes call outbound Microsoft or Redwood-managed endpoints.

Highlights: 
- No inbound firewall openings required other than optional webhook callback on port 443 (TLS).
- Outbound domains: api.redwood.ai, metrics.redwood.ai, storage.azure.net.
- We include a verification handshake for telemetry opt-in during the trial period; we can toggle that per ACME preference.

I've also cc'd marketplace-support@microsoft.com to request a short technical gate review once ACME confirms the assets. If MS wants any additional evidence (SOC link, audit contact), ping the thread and we'll attach.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_marketplace_arm_snippet.json (json)]
